visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older woman with glasses, wearing a blue t-shirt and a white headband, stands against a red brick wall holding a white string. A younger man in a black t-shirt and a black baseball cap stands beside her, looking at the string. A cameraman with a mask is visible in the background. (2) Close-up shots show a table filled with various ingredients: brown eggs, green scallions, purple shallots, white garlic bulbs, dried shrimp, dried mushrooms, raw pork pieces, dried squid, and bags of white glutinous rice. (3) The older woman's hands demonstrate folding two large green bamboo leaves into a cone shape. She uses a metal spoon to add a layer of rice and peanuts from a large silver bowl. (4) Close-up on the filling process: a piece of braised meat, dried squid, a mushroom, and a salted egg yolk are placed into the center of the rice. Another layer of rice is added on top. (5) The younger man (Joe) attempts to fold the leaf over the rice at a yellow sink area. He appears focused but slightly clumsy, while his mother watches from the side. (6) A woman with hair in a bun and glasses (Joe's wife) is shown trying to tie the white string around a wrapped zongzi. Her hands pull the string tightly. (7) A large stainless steel pot on a gas stove is shown filled with bundles of zongzi submerged in boiling water. Steam rises from the pot. A hand pours more hot water from a black skillet into the large pot. (8) Joe holds a blue and white patterned plate filled with a mountain of finished, dark green wrapped zongzi. He smiles at the camera in a domestic kitchen setting. (9) Joe's wife and a young boy in a blue polo shirt take bites of an unwrapped, sticky rice zongzi. The interior shows the succulent meat and yellow egg yolk. Joe concludes by holding a half-eaten zongzi to the camera.
